Selection click sound
Source: Kenney, Interface Sounds (1.0), Audio/click_001.ogg
https://kenney.nl/assets/interface-sounds
License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0) 1.0 Universal
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

selection-click.wav is a mono WAV conversion with a 3000 Hz low-pass filter.
Playback gain is reduced in sound.js. The original recording is by Kenney.
CC0 permits commercial use and modification without attribution.
No background music is included.
